name: Y and E
source:
I (the protagonist) have two childhood friends.
They're brothers; one of them is a hard-working president of the student council, and the other a truant shut-in.
We've always been living together happily, but due to a certain event, our relationship takes a dramatic turn...

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18346]Freem![/url]]
